name: buyme-acoffee
title: Buy Me Coffee Button
blurb: Animated coffee cup card that reveals text and scales on hover.
description: A clickable card linking to a Buy Me Coffee profile with SVG graphics that transform via CSS animations on hover. The card is fully responsive and supports dark mode via theme tokens.
use_when: You want a polished call-to-action link to a donation or support page that feels interactive and branded.
avoid_when: The card requires 24rem height and width by default; it may overflow small viewports or confined containers without…
a11y: Renders an anchor element with proper link semantics. Focus and keyboard navigation are handled by the browser. No prefers-reduced-motion guard applied.
